description: Label applied by an allow-listed account (op-1), then later removed by a non-allow-listed account (stranger-1). The seam is asked about the label the issue carries in its payload: even though the removal has taken the label off the issue's live state, the payload's labels list still names it, and authorization is about who applied the label, not who removed it — the application event's actor is allow-listed, so the label remains authorized.

issue.title: Steer: which release carries the new scheduler?
